what: B-roll story: footage and photos under a voice; clips trimmed to their scenes, stills with Ken Burns and parallax, one grade; the phrase in the lower third, the stressed word in an accent box
title: Every notification is a *small* alarm.
intent: Let real pictures carry what the voice does not say, under captions that read on any image
action: Each scene shows its clip or photo (stills push, pan or tilt in code, with parallax when a cut-out is given), all under one grade; the phrase being said sits in the lower third, words landing as they are spoken, the stressed one in a red box
make_it_yours: Ingest your clips and photos with their licence (`broll.py ingest`), run `voice_plan.py` for the voice, then `broll.py shotlist`, fill shots.json with a file per scene, and `broll.py assemble`. The grade lives in assets/broll/timeline.json (contrast, saturate, warmth, lift).
craft_note: The picture adds what the voice does not say. Video carries its own blur; stills move in code so they are sub-pixel smooth. One grade for every source makes three origins read as one film. The gradient and shadow under the lower third are what keep captions readable on bright footage.
look: Documentary: real footage, one warm grade, white type with a red accent box
